text:
Late nights staring at myself, don't even know who's looking back
Putting on these faces like I'm changing into different masks
Built these walls so damn high, can't remember what's inside
Every smile's fake as hell, every word's a place to hide
They want perfect so I give them what they think they wanna see
While the real me's choking, man, I can't let myself breathe
Counting down the hours till I can drop this whole charade
But the longer that I fake it, more myself just fades away
Mirror's showing strangers, every talk feels like I'm lying
Walking through my own damn life but inside I'm slowly dying
Looking good up on the surface but I'm breaking underneath
Playing games where being real's like pulling out your teeth
Don't ask what burns inside my chest
Don't ask why I can't find rest
You don't wanna know
I'm such a fucking mess
Life's a game with written rules and I've been playing way too long
Dancing to their beat while everything inside feels wrong
Every thing they want from me's like a rope around my throat
Every rule they made up keeps my real self locked and broke
I'm just acting in a movie that I never chose to be in
Playing parts that kill me but they always keep me bleeding
Hurting through the bandages they told me not to show
Screaming in the quiet that they're never gonna know
Pressure in my head like my skull's about to crack
Fighting with the voices that keep stabbing in my back
Time is running short and I can feel it in my soul
Either speak my truth or die inside this empty role
